text: The Kerala Prohibition of charging Exorbitant Interest Act 2012 2012-ലെ കേരള അമിതപലിശ ഈടാക്കല്‍ നിരോധന ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20132 Act Number: 2 Enactment Date: 2013-01-07 Act Year: 2013 Short Title: The Kerala Prohibition of charging Exorbitant Interest Act 2012 Hindi Title: 2012-ലെ കേരള അമിതപലിശ ഈടാക്കല്‍ നിരോധന ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to prohibit lending of money for exorbitant interest and to provide for stringent punishment for charging exorbitant interest in the money lending business in the State of Kerala and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
